target: forge.sh pr-state — a /pull/ URL with gh absent from PATH prints UNKNOWN and exits 0 (control: a gitlab MR on the same PATH still reaches the transport)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests/7" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
fx_gh pr_view 0 MERGED
fx_nogh
command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "gh-still-on-path"
fx_run pr-state https://github.com/o/r/pull/3; echo "nogh=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"
echo "gh_calls=$(fx_count gh pr)"
fx_run pr-state https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7; echo "control=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"
echo "reqs=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_done
